name: Agitated Carnivorous Plants

source.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

disable: DC 25 Survival check (trained) to distract or trick the plants or DC 22 Nature check (expert) to calm the plants

items.name: Trapping Vines
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within reach of the carnivorous plants' vines

---

Effect The vines wrap around the triggering creature. The creature must succeed at a DC 22 Reflex save save or be Grabbed until it Escapes. Whether or not the creature is grabbed, the plants make a gnawing plants Strike against the creature.

text: Many carnivorous plants that were once kept satiated now hunger for any meat they can get, even lashing out onto the path to get it.
